conditions.requirement: Ordered valid selector, original bounds/negative-index/duplicate semantics; raw aux and I generation readonly through last use.
Preserve one main15360D dot and output BF16 barrier; changed tiling/native reduction order requires a separate precision contract.
TP rank-to-feature weight order and [P,M,C]->[M,P*C] map, padding and valid-row extents retained.
Complete5120D denominator, matching gamma/epsilon and BF16 output; local640 norm excluded.
Original Nc from query_start_loc_cpu and original persistent destination extent/stride/tail; no shape-based Nc substitution.
Explicit inherited bank reader retained; external/dynamic aliases, capture addresses, other read epochs and readiness protected.
DSpark274 input/query/context position/slot/token-index outputs and rejection/anchor/DCP effects remain.
Row-owner scheme has complete main weight plus valid quantization metadata/version; logical150MiB capacity/load cost assessed, not assumed free.
N physical versus M selected rows, padding, owner routing, duplicate IDs and selection-availability timing retained; N24->M12 can double main row work.
All raw auxiliary gather consumers retained or independently closed before removing target-side gathers.
Feature-sharded RMS has globally correct rounded-y statistics, FP32 reduction/eps/gamma and BF16 boundaries; new collective measured only if implemented later.
Feature-sharded downstream KV supplies all partials and consumer layouts; no assumed gain if original full context gather remains.
Three separate KV weight/norm/config/cache domains; a joint output keeps three512D norms and individual BF16 results.
Preserve64D interleaved rotary and actual native input dtype; lookup FP32 reuse alone does not remove internal Casts.
Original rotary tail view write is retained or proved private with no intervening observer.
Same context position values/extent/readiness over loop; metadata/rejection/DCP/anchor mapping retained.
Stable layer_info/registry/full tables and valid layer names/groups; union filtering does not require all layer configs equal.
Hoisted C/S consumers do not modify shared lookup output; lifetime covers all layer last reads.
If existing use_cache=True is chosen: registered runtime/spec buffers, capacity, draft_index and mutable-buffer readiness/last-reader contract verified.
Slot-pair reuse only within same source group-bank/value generation and block-size/layout policy, not same shapes.
Invalid -1 pair convention, true page stride, bounds and original duplicate-slot input/write order preserved.
All per-layer caches/current-query writes and same-request noncausal attention readiness preserved; no scatter deletion from index CSE.
Packed-cache route has its own native writer contract; standard pair-scatter proof does not cover it.
Before computing KV at row owners, all owners have the same intended per-layer WKV/norm/rotary parameters and versions; ReplicatedLinear source is not a live-value measurement.
All full-context bank observers retained or closed before substituting KV-row gathers; original receiver slot sequence maintained.
Empty global context/positions/slots, per-layer None, dummy/is_profile allocation and warmup branches retained; no model/profile work deleted solely as dummy.
Cross-iteration reuse keys include request/accepted context/position/slot/layer-weight/RoPE-config/rollback epochs and last readers; no address-only cache.
New weight traffic, launches, collectives, synchronization and overlap interference priced jointly; TASK sums/logical bytes are not speedup.
